user.description: Pick a Shelly BLU button that a Bluetooth adapter of Home Assistant currently sees. The button has to be paired with that adapter once, see the documentation.

data_description.address: Buttons in range of an adapter that can connect. Buttons seen only through a Bluetooth proxy that forwards advertisements are not listed.

confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address})? Home Assistant connects once to check that the button is paired with its Bluetooth adapter.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Is the button paired with the Bluetooth adapter of Home Assistant, and in its range?
error.not_paired: The button refused the access. Pair it with the Bluetooth adapter of Home Assistant first, see the documentation.

abort.already_configured: This button is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This button is already being set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Shelly BLU button in range of an adapter that can connect.

not_in_range.message: {name} is out of range of every Bluetooth adapter that can connect.

not_paired.message: {name} refused the access: the button is not paired with the Bluetooth adapter of Home Assistant.

buzz.name: Buzz
buzz.description: Starts the buzzer and stops it after the given time.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds until the buzzer is stopped. The button stops it by itself after a minute.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: 0 off, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. Without it the buzzer volume of the button is used.
